items.question: Within how many weeks of being signed by the President are UAE federal laws published in the Official Gazette?
items.gold: Federal laws are published within two weeks of being signed by the President.
items.fact: Federal laws published in Official Gazette within two weeks of signing

items.question: How many registered lawyers were recorded with the UAE Ministry of Justice by March 2016?
items.gold: The number of registered lawyers in the Ministry of Justice reached 783 by March 2016.
items.fact: Registered lawyers at Ministry of Justice reached 783 by March 2016
